title: Pinned KOReader SDL control comparison
scope: New Mac SDL frames; authored EPUB and two StarDict dictionaries; English day-mode profile; literal top submenus to depth2. Dynamic factory expansion and invoking leaf actions were not part of this visual capture; applicable reading behaviors are not excluded and remain subject to source and workflow comparison. Contextual Wikipedia and translation from selected or visible reading text are in scope under K15. General network utilities, article export, online book acquisition, remote annotation export and sync controls remain reference-only and excluded. rust_comparison_commit and its source hashes describe an earlier frozen candidate; the current source candidate has removed its OPDS acquisition and remote progress-sync modules.
normalization: Only QA/profile absolute paths are replaced. Raw control text is retained; readable_text removes decorative PUA glyphs without guessing their meaning.
evidence_interpretation: workflow means an implemented native workflow exists, not exact UI, engine or native acceptance. open-audit means no exact option mapping was established, not proof all related functionality is absent. Excluded controls are reference-only and do not enter the completion denominator. Handler metadata records source functions without executing their callbacks.

navigation.title: Reading navigation
navigation.rust_summary: Contents, bookmarks, go-to, map, page previews, skim, automatic turns and return history have native entry points. Automatic-turn timeouts persist across Reader restarts and accept custom values from 1 to 86,400 seconds; fractional scroll-distance parity remains open.

contents.title: Contents
contents.rust_summary: Contents has nested search, row/font settings, labels and known chapter lengths. Depth selection reaches chapter jumps and marker tracks with known page coordinates.

bookmarks.title: Bookmarks and notes
bookmarks.rust_summary: In-book bookmarks have saved row count and title font preferences plus note/date sorting. The cross-book browser has History, collection and metadata filtering. Additional typography choices and automatic sidecar export remain open.

links.title: Links and footnotes
links.rust_summary: Internal/external-link dispatch, return history and optional footnote previews exist. Full stock link hit-area, swipe and popup preference catalogs are not established.

fonts.title: Reading font
fonts.rust_summary: Local and supported embedded font selection, fallback, weight, contrast and script coverage are implemented. Native rasterizers and every stock font-menu option are not equivalent.

styles.title: Publisher and user styles
styles.rust_summary: Independent preset subset, global defaults, per-book tri-state and bounded strict user CSS are supported. This is not the full KOReader tweak catalog or its CREngine render modes.

typography.title: Language and hyphenation
typography.rust_summary: Reader has saved main language, embedded tags, default and fallback controls. US/UK English patterns, discretionary breaks, user rules and CJK behavior are available. Broader CREngine dictionaries and language-specific line breaking remain open.

highlight.title: Selection and highlight appearance
highlight.rust_summary: Four drawing styles, named colors, opacity/height, note markers, selection color and confirmed atomic apply-all exist. Selection dialog placement offers Top, Center, Bottom and selected-text modes, with Center matching stock. All nine long-press actions and the stock single-word dictionary default/opt-out are implemented. Optional Off/Style/Color/Style and color prompts save per-mark appearance for EPUB and PDF without changing future book defaults. Desktop hold lifecycle now paints a temporary selection, extends it with paced hold-pan, and applies the configured action on release. Very-long press defaults to 3.0 seconds and is configurable from 0.9 to 20.0 seconds; corner scroll uses leave/re-enter gating. PDF selection now extends across pages and saves continuation geometry/text, bounded to readable pages, 64 pages and 8,192 UTF-8 bytes. Kindle timing/zone comparison and real Documents acceptance remain open.

dictionary.title: Offline dictionary
dictionary.rust_summary: Multiple StarDict sources, priorities, history, synonyms, bounded spelling/forms, result chooser, nested lookup, find, vocabulary and scroll overlays exist. Stock external-app integration, presets/downloads and arbitrary popup layout settings remain separate.

wiki.title: Wikipedia
wiki.rust_summary: Reader has a bounded text worker and a separate contextual image worker. EPUB export and other stock Wikipedia options are tracked separately.

search.title: Document search
search.rust_summary: Asynchronous all-results search, next/previous, history, case/accent/regular-expression controls and retained source ranges exist. Stock per-result layout settings need separate comparison.

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary review
vocabulary.rust_summary: Saved source context, review scheduling, due views, edit/remove/reset and repeated-word confirmation are implemented; full plugin option parity is not asserted.

library.title: Library and metadata
library.rust_summary: Typed folder navigation, recent/previous, favorites, collections, reading status, details, descriptions and covers are implemented.

defaults.title: Document defaults
defaults.rust_summary: Separate reflow/fixed templates apply to unseen books; save, reset and clear preserve saved source positions and use transactional writes. Reset retains fixed crop/pan.

flows.title: Custom contents and hidden flows
flows.rust_summary: Source-anchored custom chapters and hidden-flow editing/navigation are implemented for supported providers; stock custom-layout settings are a larger catalog.

numbering.title: Stable and publisher pages
numbering.rust_summary: Publisher references, source information, list/footer/margin choices and generated character-count pages are implemented with anchored destinations.

overlap.title: Page overlap
overlap.rust_summary: Continuous/page reading and footer overlap exist, but stock overlapping text lines and five overlap indicators are not equivalent to footer overlap.

gestures.title: Reader gestures
gestures.rust_summary: Seventeen single-contact corner/edge/diagonal bindings, display drags and a bounded action list are supported. Multiswipes, two-finger/pinch/rotation and the full timing/action catalog are not implemented.

footer.title: Reading footer
footer.rust_summary: Reader has independently selectable ordered metrics, cycling and combined status, book/chapter tracks, overlap, chapter marks, tap lock and hold-to-skim. The item set includes chapter page progress and measured dynamic filler. Additional device and provider status items remain open.

topheader.title: Independent engine top status header
topheader.rust_summary: The independent top status header is configurable across reflowable books, with per-book activation and new-book defaults. It preserves the original footer and source position.

timer.title: Read alarm and interval
timer.rust_summary: Alarm/interval, stop, message/notification/nothing, editable tokenized message, repeat and header/footer countdown exist with monotonic suspend handling.

statistics.title: Reading statistics
statistics.rust_summary: Filtered persisted intervals, distinct/reread totals, daily/book history, month calendar/day drill-down and clipped timelines exist. Older undated screen time stays separate. Full time-range/weekly/monthly statistics, cloud sync and destructive history tools remain open.

sync.title: Progress sync
sync.rust_summary: Historical frozen baseline only: the earlier candidate implemented opt-in WebDAV/ETag sync. Its modules and worker have been removed from the current source. K22 is excluded, not an open gap; local progress and reading-data backups remain in scope.

export.title: Annotation exports
export.rust_summary: Library exports filter eligible marks from History, selected books and collections, and combine Kindle clippings when requested. Local destination, single-book source folder, and book-title naming options apply to files written by the annotation exporters. Local filename templates cover the stock token catalog and final one-book versus multiple-book scope, with Reader's legacy defaults when empty.

translation.title: Translation
translation.rust_summary: Cancellable selected/current-page translation and source/target choices exist. Stock romanization and every provider/language override preference are not established.

metadata.title: Reading-data storage
metadata.rust_summary: Atomic library storage, configurable save intervals, supported KOReader import/export and selective backups exist. Stock per-book/hash metadata locations/archive sidecars are not identical.

end.title: End-of-book behavior
end.rust_summary: Nine end actions plus automatic finished marking are implemented with confirmation for deletion, retained positions and provider-specific end detection.

launcher.title: System and Launcher ownership
launcher.rust_summary: PrimitiveOS Launcher owns system Wi-Fi, clock/time zone, sleep/wallpaper, battery, storage and device management. This row is an ownership decision, not a claim that advanced KOReader system settings are reproduced.

localization.title: Interface language
localization.rust_summary: Frozen Reader chrome is English and left-to-right. Unicode book text and dictionary support do not implement 44 interface translations or mirrored interface controls.

application.title: Application shell
application.rust_summary: Reader has Done/Exit, Help/About/version information and persistent app settings. Stock restart/plugin/patch/menu-search workflows are not all equivalent.

network-extra.title: Optional reading service gap
network-extra.rust_summary: Historical frozen baseline only: OPDS acquisition and WebDAV progress-sync providers were implemented in an earlier candidate. Both have been removed from the current source; these upstream controls remain excluded reference evidence.

excluded.title: Outside core reading scope
excluded.rust_summary: Terminal, RSS downloader, HTTP inspector/server administration and unrelated utilities are excluded by the reading-parity requirements. Retain these rows only as KOReader source references; they are not Reader tasks, gaps, or completion counts.
